milestones.title: Project scaffolding, pyproject.toml, config loader, and smoke tests
Public 50-200 page PDF corpus acquisition script and corpus manifest
PDF text extractor and cleaner preserving page numbers and section headers
Token-aware overlapping chunker (300-600 tokens) with citation metadata
Ingestion CLI building chunks.jsonl and chunk statistics report
Gemini embedding client (gemini-embedding-001) with batching and disk cache
Persistent FAISS/Chroma vector store implementation and tests
BM25 keyword index with persistence and unit tests
Hybrid retriever combining dense + BM25 with Reciprocal Rank Fusion
Cross-encoder reranker module with configurable top-K/top-N and toggle
Unified retrieval pipeline and CLI score comparison inspector
Citation-grounded prompt template and Gemini (gemini-3.8-flash) generator
Programmatic citation verifier validating cited chunk IDs against retrieved context
End-to-end RAG query pipeline and ask.py CLI with refusal handling
Golden evaluation schema and initial 30 curated Q&A pairs with source passages
Expand golden set to 60+ Q&A pairs including 12+ unanswerable refusal cases
Retrieval metrics (Hit@5, Recall@5, MRR) and refusal accuracy evaluator
Faithfulness, answer correctness, and citation-support evaluator + run_eval.py
Ablation harness testing chunk size (300/450/600) and overlap variations
Retrieval & reranker ablations (BM25 vs Dense vs Hybrid, Reranker) + Markdown table
Failure-case analysis script and categorized error breakdown (docs/failure_analysis.md)
Interactive Streamlit/Gradio demo app with query input and retriever toggles
Clickable inline citations UI displaying file, page, section, and passage
Evaluation and ablation dashboard view in demo app + UI smoke tests
Final README with architecture, ablation results table, and failure cases + full test pass
